name: Conveyor
title: Belt conveyor with product tracking
description: A belt section posed from the encoder distance the PLC reports, with a blade stopper. Products are placed from one distance value, modulo the pitch, so the view is correct at any speed and after any jump.

joints.name: belt
joints.nothingAttached: Product flow is drawn by update(): the belt itself does not move as a rigid body, so no geometry hangs off this node.
